column1: # Single source of truth for rebot-vision models on reCamera (SG2002 / CV181x).
#   bundled  = copied into /usr/share/rebot-teleop/models in the .deb; CDN is fallback/update source; required for optimal
#   os       = ships with reCamera OS in /usr/share/supervisor/models
#   optional = CDN only; not bundled in the .deb and not required for optimal
#   detector-segment (seg384 fuse, 5ad01b51): model_tool ION 12.54 MB (catalogue 13.1 MB), standalone CVI_NN_Forward
#     32.0 ms (vs 71.2 ms stock 640x640), live yolo.ms p50 67.0-73.6 ms, decode p50 7.7-9.9 ms, mask p50 24.1 ms,
#     total ION 34.31 MB alone / 54.29 MB with ZipDepth (8.6 MB free of 62.9 MB carveout).
#   depth (zipdepth tabletop round 1, d0a6ee39): model_tool ION 19.10 MB (catalogue 20.0 MB), pure TPU 54.9 ms,
#     live depth.ms p50 71.3-74.2 ms, held-out table abs median 33.8 mm (4.0 mm after per-frame plane fit),
#     on-device 8/8 poses 4-19 mm residual (vs 2,245.3 mm for retired room-scale Stage C 33478718).
#   detector-detect (stock OS, 7819bd8d): model_tool ION 7.69 MB (catalogue 8.5 MB), 80 COCO classes.
#   detector-segment-fallback (stock OS 640x640, b3312af4): model_tool ION 17.91 MB (catalogue 19.5 MB); cannot coexist with depth.
#   detector-obb (optional, d9607b70): model_tool ION 7.24 MB (catalogue 8.0 MB), 15 DOTAv1 classes.
